description: Three separate oscillators side by side, each with its own tuning and pulse width, and each giving a sine, a triangle, a falling ramp and a square.

params.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch over four octaves, -2 to +2; at the middle of its travel the oscillator sounds C4.
Scales that oscillator's Mod input before it is added to the pitch in volts, 0 to 1. It starts at 0, so the jack reaches nothing until this is turned up.
Scales that oscillator's Pwm input before it shifts the pulse width, 0 to 1. It starts at 0, so the jack reaches nothing until this is turned up.
Detunes that oscillator by about half a semitone either way, -1 to +1.
Narrows that oscillator's pulse, 0 to 1. The pulse stays fully open over the bottom half of the travel and only begins to narrow past the middle, closing at the top.

inputs.text: Shifts that oscillator's pulse width, taken between -5V and +5V and scaled by the Pwm knob; with Pwm at 0 nothing here reaches the pulse width.
Added to that oscillator's pitch in volts, scaled by the Mod knob; with Mod at 0 nothing here reaches the pitch.
Sets that oscillator's pitch at 1V an octave, added to the Tune knob.

outputs.text: A square at that oscillator's pitch, swinging ±5V, its width set by the Pulse knob.
A sine at that oscillator's pitch, swinging ±5V.
A falling ramp at that oscillator's pitch, swinging ±5V.
A triangle at that oscillator's pitch, swinging ±5V.

notes: the module prints a line of debugging text for each of its three oscillators on every sample, which fills Rack's log file and costs processor time.
the maker named none of the fifteen knobs and none of the twenty-one jacks, so hovering one shows no name; the panel lettering is the only naming there is.
the three oscillators are wholly separate: nothing on the panel joins one to another.
every jack reads one channel and every output writes one channel.
